firmware_toolchain.comparison: Generated platform/framework pins match retained Woonkamer build; no implicit upgrade to the active ESPHome Builder 2026.8.2.
firmware_toolchain.native_source_comparison: No changes in experiments/native-duplex-v1 between 8c2e872e0184265f757f3ff5da9b70d16917dac2 and the source revision.

woonkamer.reason: Retained reviewed firmware inputs and binaries unchanged; reuse existing candidate and rebuilt recovery images.

overkapping.binary_binding_checks: Both formats contain the Overkapping device name and exclude Woonkamer; candidate embeds its own credential, matching service grant hash, existing CA and final endpoint; recovery excludes native speaker endpoint.
overkapping.configuration_preservation: Wi-Fi, API, OTA and network unchanged; switch, binary_sensor, sensor, script, button, select, media_player and light identities retained. Native media/wake/stop/mute arbitration uses the unchanged reviewed helper. Physical behavior not asserted.

verification.execution: Network-disabled, read-only containers using packaged source. First run: 57 passed, one missing identity fixture and two missing OpenSSL fixture errors. Identity fixture restored: five speaker tests passed, including the previously failed case. Exact two remaining TLS cases passed with a host OpenSSL executable and matching libraries supplied only to those test containers; runtime image unchanged.
preparer_guards: wrong household device rejected without creating output
output inside product checkout rejected without creating output
verification.limitations: No actual microphone, playback, device session, firmware flash or hardware recovery. Rebuilt recovery binaries do not replace an original full-flash backup.

preparation_corrections: Initial preservation assertion incorrectly demanded unchanged media callbacks; existing helper intentionally rewires native start/stop arbitration. Network and credential equality remains asserted; component identity retention checked separately.
Initial generated credential used hexadecimal; ESPHome validation rejected it before compilation. Corrected to required 32-byte base64url and rebuilt in a new private output directory.
Initial image build context encountered root-owned Python bytecode from helper import. Used isolated source-only context excluding bytecode; preparer now disables bytecode output.
next_boundary: Independent review, coordinator-controlled server activation and scoped network provisioning, then device-specific physical USB identification/full-flash backup/recovery verification before any flash.
